source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.presence: actual standard WOFOST only when exact B1.10 continuation enters the LAIEXP>=6 carryover regime
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.reason: GLAI recomputes GLAIEXP only while LAIEXP<6, but update_wofost adds the saved prior GLAIEXP to LAIEXP on every later daily call
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.minimum_storage: one scalar plus presence/regime semantics, only for execution paths requiring exact B1.10 code continuation
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.transaction_semantics: candidate-local and checkpointed with the reference trajectory; rejected events cannot advance it

source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.presence: IDSL=2 only when exact B1.10 post-completion VERN continuation is required
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.reason: after fl_vernalised becomes true the rate can remain saved while vern=vern+vernrate still executes
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.affects_future_physical_state: no subsequent standard-route DVS feedback found after completion; affects legacy VERN continuation/output
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.minimum_storage: one scalar only for the narrow IDSL=2 compatibility path
source_oracle_compatibility_continuation.transaction_semantics: candidate-local; rejected events cannot advance it

diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.name: first_warning
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.classification: diagnostic warning latch, not physical crop continuation

diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.name: DWRT/DWST/DWLV
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.classification: standard-route cumulative output/diagnostic in this scoped analysis; grass management is excluded

diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.name: r%gla
diagnostic_or_nonphysical_state.classification: saved but no scoped cross-event state feedback found after LAIEXP>=6

transaction_boundary.physical_rule: phenology/climate memory, lifecycle, biomass and enabled root history form one candidate physical crop continuation
transaction_boundary.reference_compatibility_rule: narrow oracle-compatibility memories, when enabled, follow the same candidate lineage and rollback/replay semantics but remain explicitly distinguished from physical crop state
